title: BuildablesResponse
description: Response shape for GET /model/buildables — the production-queue buildable registry. Fixed installation/auto buildables first (in registry order), then one entry per per-player ship/starbase design slot. Clients resolve queue ids and drive the add-item picker from this instead of hardcoding the build-object-id scheme.

build-object-id.description: Flat buildable registry id the host stores in a planet build queue (e.g. 7=factory, 8=mine, 9=defenses; 1024+N=design slot N). The single source of truth is game::objects::buildable; see docs/mechanics/production.rst.

kind.description: Semantic kind slug (lower-snake). Matches production_item.item.kind in request-submit-orders.json for the fixed buildables (factory, mine, defenses, alchemy, auto_factory, auto_mine, auto_defenses, auto_alchemy, auto_min_terraform, auto_max_terraform, auto_max_factories, auto_max_mines); 'design' for a design-slot buildable. Engine-emitted from the fixed registry and validated by the buildables contract test, so the value set is documented here rather than enforced as a generated enum (see docs/adr/0003 on weighing constraints against type churn).

name.description: Human-facing display name (e.g. 'Factory', 'Auto Maximum Mines', 'Design Slot 0').

design-slot.description: Present only when category is ship-design: the player design slot this buildable maps to (build-object-id = 1024 + design-slot). Absent for fixed installation/auto buildables.

buildable-category.description: What class of buildable this is. 'installation' = a one-off installation (factory, mine, defenses, alchemy); 'auto' = an auto-build item that repeats until a limit; 'ship-design' = a ship or starbase built from one of the player's design slots.
